before.label: fig:idea
before.caption:
An observed OLMo-2-7B trace. The name suggests sum 8, but the code counts two
items. Including source expressions in worked examples changes the first reported value from 8 to 2
and the final answer from 15 to 9. Only the example format changes.

before.label: fig:story
before.caption:
\textbf{(a)} Correct digits predicted immediately before wrong sum writes.
\textbf{(b)} Worked examples use \texttt{v = 2} or \texttt{v = len(xs) = 2}; including
\texttt{len(xs)} reduces extra sum writes. The replication uses independently screened
names and fresh programs; Table~\ref{tab:round6-replication} gives intervals.

before.label: fig:mechanism
before.caption:
\textbf{(a)} Incorrect sum writes removed by replacing internal activity with the
ordinary-name program's activity, at the name (red) or just before the value (blue).
\textbf{(b)} A separate predictor reads the correct digit on held-out misleading-name
programs. \textbf{(c)} Correct writes made wrong by name replacement; note the smaller scale.
Columns show distinct measurements, not a common error rate.
